tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing Operation and Maintenance of Multi-Village- Water Supply Scheme to Kamathana Other 17 Villages in Bidar Taluka of Bidar District (For 5Year of O&M)

itemList.description:
OPERATION & MAINTENANCE for 1st Year to 5th Year: 1) Establishment:
Operation& Maintenance of the scheme as per TOR (Terms of Reference) which includes providing sufficient technical staff, valve man, helpers, watchman, operators, Electrician and other who are required to run the system in complete manner and providing required materials,
Pumping machinery at intermediate sump to villages (Kamthana & other 17 villages pipeline repair works. 2) Regular maintenance of civil structures Regular maintenance of civil structures like pure water sump, pump house, and all other Civil structures. The Maintenance consist of all kinds of repair to damaged structure cleaning & washing and painting for civil structures. Entire infrastructure must be maintained in good working condition through out the year so as to ensure un-istarupted water supply to all the habitations through out the year and repairs and replacement of damaged pipeline valves etc.if found necessary it includes cost of materials and labour charges and also monitoring systems the maintenance involves Pure water raising mains, gravity mains, maintaining the required discharge the quantum of water in all mains. 3) Operation and Maintenance : Maintaining the quality of water as per guidelines CPHEEO manual and Bureau of Indian Standards IS 10500:2012 specification including cost of testing of water at
laboratory twice in a month and generating the reports duly submitting to the division. 4) Operation and Maintenance of all kinds of pumping machineries: Operation and maintenance of pumping machineries established in intermediate sump, and other mechanical components of
the scheme with due care by pump operators duly lubricating, greasing with all required care and should run the pumps satisfactorily including electrical maintenance covering all repairs replacement of electrical cable/switch board, replacement of burnt parts of machinery. Replacement of all parts of machinery will be carried out as per the direction of the engineer in
charge for satisfactory functioning of the scheme to provide the designed discharge of drinking water to all the habitations of the project. 5) Transportation and Communication Charges: Transportation Charges include cost of mobilization of staff for satisfactory functioning of all
pumps, Sumps all other components of scheme. Providing uniform to staff, precautionary accessories such as wellington shoes, torch, helmet, hand gloves etc. required to discharge their duties satisfactorily. The communication charge includes cost of communication to the staff
through mobile phones for conversation amongst the staff spared over the project Note: Helper/ watch man/valve man/electrician/technical staff made available round the clock for maintenance period at all sumps. 1. The GP or VWSC/concerned section officer of the project certify the satisfactory functioning of the scheme and based on this payment will be made to the
contractor. 2. The contractor should maintain a log book on the working of all pumping machineries, intermediate sumps including day today records of units consumed per day. The payment will be made by the Engineer in charges for satisfactory report of every month end (The
GP secretary and SO in charges of WSS should give satisfactory report) subject to condition appended in TOR.Complete with all lead and lift loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer in-charge of the work. (Excluding energy charges) Note:-Contractor should execute the work as per the technical sanctioned estimate Quantities like Establishment, Consumables,
transportation and communication, office accommodation, stationery charges, etc., which is attached. The bidder shall quote for the 5year O&M cost against the total estimated cost of 8,25,50,000.00. The year wise breakup amount shall be calculated as per percentage given below : Year 1 : 18.10%, Year 2 : 19.00%, Year 3 : 19.95%, Year 4 : 20.95%, Year 5 : 22.00%
